gizlilik.title: Privacy policy
gizlilik.lead: {{company}} explains how order, account and support data is used.

sections.p: Name, email, phone, delivery address, order contents and payment result. Card numbers are not stored here. Google sign-in shares the verified email and name.
To fulfill the order, ship it, provide support, meet legal retention duties and, if you opt in, send a newsletter.
The payment provider, carrier and host see only what the transaction requires. We do not sell personal data.
Order records are kept for the period required by tax and consumer law. Account requests: {{email}}. The session cookie is HttpOnly.
Contract performance, payment, delivery, support, fraud prevention and legal duties.
Contract, legal obligation and legitimate interest. The newsletter needs a separate opt-in.
You may request access, correction or deletion by emailing {{email}}. You may also apply to the Turkish data protection authority.

mesafeli-satis.title: Distance sales contract
mesafeli-satis.lead: This contract applies to sales made on this site with {{company}}.

sections.p: Sale and delivery of handmade goods. Small differences in handmade pieces are not defects.
The total is shown in the order summary. Cards are charged by the payment provider. Bank transfer is final only after the payment is confirmed. Unpaid orders are not shipped.
Ready-made goods may be withdrawn within 14 days of delivery. Made-to-order or hygiene-sensitive goods may be excluded when stated on the product page.

on-bilgilendirme.title: Pre-contract information
on-bilgilendirme.lead: By placing an order you confirm you have read the seller, price and withdrawal terms.

sections.p: Name, quantity, discounts, shipping and total are in the checkout summary. Cards are entered on the payment page. The delivery address is the one you enter.

iade.title: Returns
iade.lead: Ready-stock items can be returned within 14 days of delivery.

sections.p: Email {{email}} with the order code and reason. Send the item unused after we confirm.
After inspection, the amount is returned via the original payment method.

kargo.title: Shipping
kargo.lead: Shipping fee and the free-shipping threshold are calculated at checkout.

sections.p: In-stock items are prepared after payment is confirmed. Made-to-order times are on the product page.
Check the parcel on delivery and email photos to {{email}} if it is damaged.
